title: Black Pepper and Honey

seo.title: Black Pepper and Honey for Cough - Ayurvedic Home Remedy
seo.description: A traditional pinch of black pepper mixed with honey, used as a simple Ayurvedic lick to ease productive cough and Kapha congestion.

purpose: A simple lick traditionally used to help clear Kapha mucus, soothe the throat and ease a productive respiratory cough.
timing: After meals or when cough is troublesome
anupana: Lick slowly; may be followed by a few sips of warm water
duration: Up to 5-7 days for a mild cough, or as advised
traditional_context: Maricha (black pepper) with Madhu (honey) is a classical household anupana for Kaphaja Kasa. Pepper is tikshna and ushna, helping to break sticky Kapha; honey is yogavahi and traditionally used in cough so long as it is never heated.

ingredients_list.notes: A pinch only; do not use a heaped spoon

preparation.step: Crush 2-3 black peppercorns, or take a small pinch of coarsely ground black pepper.
Mix the pinch into 1/2 teaspoon of raw honey at room temperature. Do not heat the honey.
Lick the mixture slowly and allow it to coat the throat. Follow with warm water if needed.

precautions.precaution: Use only a pinch of pepper. Larger amounts can burn the throat and stomach.
Never heat honey. Do not give honey to infants under one year of age.
This does not replace medical care for breathlessness, high fever, chest pain or a lingering cough.

who_should_avoid.warning: People with ulcers, severe gastritis, marked Pitta, or pepper allergy should avoid this mix.
Diabetics should account for honey and seek professional advice before using it regularly.
